title: Largest Component Size by Common Factor
goal: Find the largest component when numbers are connected by a common factor greater than one.
strategy: Factor each number into distinct primes. The first owner of each prime is a representative; union every later number carrying that prime. Transitive factor chains combine into full connected components.
